'''Imperial Ordinance 33-618''' was a law of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Paragraph c of the ordinance stated that the [[Ministry of War (Sith Empire)|Ministry of War]] was to issue incentives to married personnel in active service.
